'''Kneepad rocket dart launchers''' were a type of knee-mounted [[Rocket dart/Legends|rocket dart]] launcher.<ref name="SWTVD" /> Notable users included [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="AotC-TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and his son [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="SWTVD" />
